message.title: Aker announces a major customer contract signed by its second largest portfolio holding
message.body:
August 26, 2026 -- Aker ASA announces that its second largest portfolio
holding, Nscale, has signed a major contract with an undisclosed customer to
provide AI compute capacity at its Monarch site in the United States. The
contract represents a total contract value of around USD 45 billion.

-ENDS-
